question: The shore temple at Mahabalipuram, notable for its rock-cut architecture, was built during the reign of which Pallava king?
solution:
The shore temple at Mahabalipuram, notable for its rock-cut architecture, was built during the reign of __**Narasimhavarman II (Rajasimha).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram is a complex of temples and shrines that overlooks the **shore of the Bay of Bengal. **
